title: Tower component equation for normalized finite Verdier comparisons
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, a prime l different from its characteristic, an algebraic closure Omega of Q_l in an independent universe, and a separated finite-type scheme X over D.k. For every finite Verdier datum F of [def-sf-common-stage-verdier-data], the tower HEq between extension of beta(E,L) followed by beta(L,M), and the stage associator at the dual followed by beta(E,M) and the contravariant dual of the stage associator. All coefficient fields are finite subextensions of Omega. The formulas include repeated coefficient fields and every stage object, including zero objects and the empty scheme.

source.place: Final coefficient-transport paragraph; core descent retained steps 1--5 and formal retract restriction step 10

proof.text:
identify the three coefficient inclusions and their composite using the
coefficient-inclusion composition law. Apply RationalVerdier.extension_composition
to the normalized extensions and use its integral normalization clause. The canonical
scalar associator has the same normalized integral component, by its uniqueness
specification. Transport the resulting equality through the stage associator and
retain the dependent endpoint equality as HEq. Repeated fields, zero objects, and the
empty scheme are included automatically.

lean.statement:
theorem finite_tower_equation (F : Finite D l hl Ω X) :
    ∀ (E L M : Index l Ω) (h : E ≤ L) (k : L ≤ M) (K : Stage l Ω X E),
    HEq
      ((transition l Ω X L M k).map ((F.beta E L h).hom.app (op K)) ≫
        (F.beta L M k).hom.app (op ((transition l Ω X E L h).obj K)))
      ((associator l Ω X E L M h k).hom.app ((F.datum E).dual.obj (op K)) ≫
        (F.beta E M (h.trans k)).hom.app (op K) ≫
          (F.datum M).dual.map ((associator l Ω X E L M h k).hom.app K).op)
